M12_exists_not_delegated._note: EXISTS / NOT EXISTS go through the operator table again: the pattern is dropped or rejected in HAVING and SELECT expressions (form 4). A8 (HAVING without grouping) reddens too: the HAVING conditions are translated through this table BEFORE the step decides whether the level groups, so a throw here fails the Filter path as well. Spec stage: also A25 (the EXISTS condition of HAVING without grouping is refused again, so its HAVING form throws while the FILTER twin answers) and A26 (EXISTS under arithmetic in a SELECT expression is refused again, the BIND twin answers).
